# Code of Conduct

nodrill is not a [Python Software Foundation](https://www.python.org/psf-landing/) project, but everyone interacting in its issues, pull requests and discussions is expected to follow the [PSF Code of Conduct](https://policies.python.org/python.org/code-of-conduct/).

In short: be open, considerate and respectful, whatever anyone's position in the project is.

## Enforcement

Reports are taken seriously and treated confidentially.
To raise one privately, email [Pavel Kutsenko](mailto:zebartcoc@gmail.com).

You can also [report to the Python Software Foundation](https://policies.python.org/python.org/code-of-conduct/Procedures-for-Reporting-Incidents/) if a report concerns the maintainer or you would rather not go through the project.
